title: Oriental Mindoro adventure research content pack
scope: Calapan City and all 14 municipalities; festivals excluded
status: Web research draft for editorial and community review. Not imported into gameplay.
methodology: Prioritize municipal/provincial government, UNESCO, cultural institutions, original laws, academic research and firsthand program reports.
Source IDs attach to individual claims. Web-documented means found in the cited source, not independently authenticated or locally approved.
Separate legends and oral accounts from historical assertions. Exclude known contradictions and promotional superlatives.
Collectibles and visitor challenges are original game proposals inferred from the sources, not documented customary practices or current site rules.
No poems, Indigenous script, recordings, photos or distinctive craft patterns are licensed by this research.
No current prices, hours, trail openings, ferry schedules or swimming-safety assurances are supplied.
